Messages.Author: Markus Schlein
Messages.Body:
Hi,

Fear of Mekhet reads:

Master. Put this card on a ready Justicar or Inner Circle member. Tap
that vampire. During his .....

I think it is possible to play the card on a tapped IC member or
Justicar and the second sentence is simply ignored then.

Correct?

Thanks for help,

Messages.Author: James Coupe
Messages.Body:
In message <3B2DF4DB...@gmx.de>, Markus Schlein
<Markus....@gmx.de> writes

>Master. Put this card on a ready Justicar or Inner Circle member. Tap
>that vampire. During his .....
>
>I think it is possible to play the card on a tapped IC member or
>Justicar and the second sentence is simply ignored then.

You can play it on a tapped vampire.

You tap the already tapped vampire. Net change: nothing. But the rest
of the card takes effect as usual.
